demo.ready_desc: Explore the app with real data and remove it whenever you like.
demo.preparing_desc: Working… (does not count toward your quota)
demo.rotate_toast: Rolled history forward by 1 year ({{count}} sessions).
demo.lab_navigate_hint: You can navigate to other pages — progress shows in the bottom-right corner and you'll get a notice when it finishes.
demo.lab_footer: Creates a realistic fictional client, generates the full plan (brief → blueprint → microcycle → progressions), and fills the logbook to the end of the chosen duration. Doesn't count toward your quota.

tour.step_banner: This is your demo client with 1 year of real data. Use it to explore every screen safely.
tour.step_open_client: Open the client page to see the assessment, photo and history.
tour.step_plan: Open the latest plan. The amber chip shows it evolved from the previous block.
tour.step_volume: Volume targets per muscle (MEV/MAV/MRV). The ↘ marker shows where the AI lowered the ceiling based on the previous block.
tour.step_capacity: Adaptation syndrome: load Δ% and e1RM per pattern vs the prior block. This is where you see the stimulus actually producing capacity.
tour.step_year: Year view: adherence, RPE and the Adaptation column summarising every block.
tour.step_lab: Demo Lab (founder only): run new simulations without affecting your quota.

next.deload_sub: High RPE or low adherence — pull back to MEV, drop RPE by 1 and rebuild.
next.normal_sub: Continue the MEV → MAV curve, rotate accessories, keep the anchors.
next.push_sub: Low RPE + high adherence — push to MAV/MRV and add 1–2 sets per pattern.

main_lift.refreshed_desc: At least one pattern has a new main lift vs the prior block — anti-stale variation applied.
main_lift.kept_desc: The AI was asked to vary the main lift but kept the same ones. No automatic action — you can adjust manually if you want a swap.

volume.section_subtitle: Check before approving — sets per muscle group against MEV/MAV/MRV (Israetel/Helms). Does not include what the client actually performed.
volume.info_mrv: maximum recoverable; above this is overreaching.
volume.info_footnote: Each set counts 1× for the primary muscle and 0.5× for each secondary. Reference values for intermediate lifters — adjust with judgement.
